title: New Business Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing"><strong>About WPP Production</strong></p> <p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message skipProofing">We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite&nbsp;cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel&nbsp;in a single company –&nbsp;powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open,&nbsp;to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http://wpp.com/__;!!JboVxjCXSME!N9KGoZIn5nCC-uOWhEdE-ChrrJuf6TgkLzNNkLaW9BExJsVqZZ_hMSmGbARJ0tdBOnKYM7kEbv5L3ncUpg7-6uEPNdY$" data-outlook-id="6ded86b6-cde3-4e48-958d-34727f881edd">WPP.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>A Hybrid working model</strong></p> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <p class="xmsonormal"><em>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</em></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>What does a&nbsp; New Business Director (Global ) do at WPP Production?</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>The Business Director - Growth &amp; Clients plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production: defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities, deepening our most important client relationships, and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function.</p> <p>Reporting into the&nbsp;Global Chief Growth Officer&nbsp;and working closely with the&nbsp;Global Chief Client Officer, this is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win and grow consistently across markets, clients and opportunity types. As a member of the&nbsp;Senior Leadership Team, you will help set the direction of the business and represent growth and clients at a senior level.</p> <p>You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities, ensuring that responses are clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across pitches you are leading, setting the standard for how we articulate our value. Equally, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, using a deep understanding of their business and objectives to grow relationships and unlock new opportunities.</p> <p>You will partner with Global Managing Partners on organic and new opportunities and the Global MD of Hex. Hex is the WPP Production Creative Technology and AI Studio specialising in generative AI, agentic AI, gaming, immersive experiences, and robotics.&nbsp;As part of this collaboration, you will come to understand our significant tech and tools partnerships.</p> <p>Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.</p> <p>Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth, defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, high-profile role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth, client satisfaction and business impact at scale.</p> <p><strong>Key areas of responsibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning</li> <li>Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across assigned pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value</li> <li>Design end-to-end client solutions, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition</li> <li>Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency</li> <li>Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus</li> <li>Partner with the Global Chief Client Officer to grow existing relationships, driving organic growth and cross-selling WPP Production's full breadth of capabilities and services</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, providing strategic insights and guidance that help them achieve their business objectives through the right production strategy</li> <li>Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach</li> <li>Support financial performance, partnering with Commercial and Finance teams on P&amp;Ls, budgets, forecasting, contribution margins and profit levers across clients and new opportunities</li> <li>Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency</li> <li>Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality</li> <li>Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings and pitch meetings</li> <li>Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring collaboration across Media, Creative and Production</li> <li>Develop and scale team capability through coaching, mentoring and training, creating a culture of collaboration, inclusion and continuous learning</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What good looks like (key requirements)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth, client leadership or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment</li> <li>Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won</li> <li>Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches</li> <li>Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines</li> <li>Expert client relationship skills in a multi-stakeholder, matrix environment, with a track record of driving up (or turning around) client satisfaction</li> <li>Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level</li> <li>Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously</li> <li>Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative, technology and production</li> <li>Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges</li> <li>A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability</li> <li>Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact</li> <li>Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-HYBRID</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-RH1</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: left;"><strong>Why work here:&nbsp;<br></strong><span data-teams="true">At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

About the role

At blp, we create cutting-edge products for automated document processing. We have dedicated engineering teams for each product. The teams fully own their product, that means we understand the business problem that our product solves and own the roadmap how the product evolves.

We have a strong sense of end-to-end ownership and a desire to have direct impact by solving real world problems. As a team, we also strive to own and shape how we work together and how we grow, both as individuals and as a team.

 

What you'll do

  • Drive Impact: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into possible improvements to our product.

  • Build Great Software: Design and develop clean, maintainable, and high-quality software, applying a wide range of principles including functional patterns. Conduct code reviews and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.

  • Lead and Influence: Guide technical direction for major initiatives, shape how the product evolves and mentor team members along the way.

  • Promote Innovation and Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues, share what you learn openly, and continuously improve processes, tools, and team practices.

  • The Tech Stack for this role includes Golang, MySQL, Docker images deployed on a Kubernetes cluster in our cloud infrastructure (GCS, AWS or Azure) and Github CI/CD.

 

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in a software engineering role.

  • Passionate about software craftsmanship: Strong understanding of software development principles, Clean Code and Clean Architecture.

  • Product thinking: Ability to translate business problems into precise requirements, specifications and ultimately into code.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: link your daily work to team and company goals, balance cost and benefit, deliver high-quality solutions efficiently.

  • Ownership: take responsibility for your technical work, for the product we build and the team we shape.

  • Team-oriented: proactively support team goals, close gaps.

  • Abstraction and efficient communication: simplify complex systems, identify core concepts, communicate complex ideas to different stakeholders.

 

What you'll get

  • Full ownership. You own the product's roadmap, from business problem to shipped code.

  • End-to-end impact. You're on a team that owns what it builds, start to finish.

  • A modern, varied tech stack. Continuous learning as the platform scales.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As a Front-End Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Marketing Manager - Manda
description: The company It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale. manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us. manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets. We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it. The team You'll be our first marketing hire, joining a founding team of circa 10 mandans. All highly motivated to finally free the SME M&A space from the lack of meaningful innovation in the space. You'll get the autonomy and pace of a startup, with the data, infrastructure and credibility of an established lender behind you. You'll report directly into the Venture Lead of manda. Your mission Your mission is to bring the right business owners to manda: people genuinely thinking about selling, at the point in their lives when they're thinking about it. Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but it doesn't scale and the pool is finite. Your job is to build the channels that reach owners who have never heard of iwoca, work out which of those channels produce real mandates at a cost our fee model can support, and shut down the ones that don't. You won't be inheriting a growth engine. We're launching our direct application journey this autumn, and filling it is your first job. You'll be building the first growth engine here, and you'll be the person who decides where the money goes. The role Find the channels that work Run cheap, fast tests across direct channels such as paid search, paid social, organic, and direct response. Prioritise those that work and kill the ones that don't, based on evidence. Own the budget and the allocation decisions. You'll start small on purpose: we'd rather learn which channel works than spend heavily on one that doesn't. Write and test the copy yourself, from ads to landing pages, and iterate on what real business owners actually respond to. Test offline as well as digital. Mail and email direct to business owners are two of the few ways to reach someone who isn't actively searching for a way out, and nobody has tested either properly for us yet. Earn coverage in the trade press. We have real deals to talk about now, and working with iwoca's comms team you should be able to turn them into a steady source of inbound interest. Prove the unit economics Establish what it actually costs us to acquire a seller mandate through each channel. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it — replacing it with a real number is one of the most valuable things you can do in your first six months. Define how we value a lead before it becomes a deal. Our conversion event is months away from first contact and worth a lot when it lands, so you'll need a sensible proxy to steer spend against. Build the measurement first Set up attribution, with needed tech support, so that customers can be traced back to the channel that produced them. Build the reporting that tells the team which channels are working, and be the person who questions a number that looks too good. Turn our website into something that converts Make the case for manda clearly: what the process involves, how long each step takes, and why we're different from a traditional broker. Use our completed deals, our team's track record and our acquisition finance offering as proof, and test what actually persuades a cautious owner to start a conversation about selling. Help us reach better buyers Sellers come first, but manda is a two-sided market. Once seller supply is working, you'll help us reach acquirers who are serious, credible and ready to transact, including buyers who are new to iwoca. The requirements Essential: Around 4+ years in acquisition, growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup, scale-up or new venture where you had to work out what to do rather than execute someone else's plan. M&A, marketplace or two-sided experience, especially where supply rather than demand was the constraint. Comfortable with a long, low-frequency, high-value conversion. Selling a business is nothing like taking out a loan: the cycle runs for months, volumes are low, and you'll have to make decisions on thin and noisy data without waiting for statistical comfort. Numerate and data-literate. You build the measurement before the campaign, you can read a funnel, and you're happy owning the numbers you report. Genuinely hands-on. There's no team and no agency to hide behind: you'll write the copy, brief the page, set up the tracking and pull the reporting yourself. Experience driving applications or sign-ups into a live product journey, and comfortable working with product and engineering on the conversion steps you don't own yourself. A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture. Bonus: Experience marketing to owner-managers of established SMEs, particularly around retirement, succession or exit. You've personally owned a paid channel with a real budget, and you've killed one that wasn't working. We care as much about the second part as the first. Regulated or financial services marketing experience. Offline direct response experience, particularly direct mail. Hands-on with HubSpot, GA4 or similar, and comfortable with SQL or a BI tool like Looker. The salary We expect to pay from £55,000–£80,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it.

The team

You'll be our first marketing hire, joining a founding team of circa 10 mandans. All highly motivated to finally free the SME M&A space from the lack of meaningful innovation in the space.

You'll get the autonomy and pace of a startup, with the data, infrastructure and credibility of an established lender behind you. You'll report directly into the Venture Lead of manda.

Your mission

Your mission is to bring the right business owners to manda: people genuinely thinking about selling, at the point in their lives when they're thinking about it.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but it doesn't scale and the pool is finite. Your job is to build the channels that reach owners who have never heard of iwoca, work out which of those channels produce real mandates at a cost our fee model can support, and shut down the ones that don't.

You won't be inheriting a growth engine. We're launching our direct application journey this autumn, and filling it is your first job. You'll be building the first growth engine here, and you'll be the person who decides where the money goes.

The role

Find the channels that work

  • Run cheap, fast tests across direct channels such as paid search, paid social, organic, and direct response. Prioritise those that work and kill the ones that don't, based on evidence.

  • Own the budget and the allocation decisions. You'll start small on purpose: we'd rather learn which channel works than spend heavily on one that doesn't.

  • Write and test the copy yourself, from ads to landing pages, and iterate on what real business owners actually respond to.

  • Test offline as well as digital. Mail and email direct to business owners are two of the few ways to reach someone who isn't actively searching for a way out, and nobody has tested either properly for us yet.

  • Earn coverage in the trade press. We have real deals to talk about now, and working with iwoca's comms team you should be able to turn them into a steady source of inbound interest.

Prove the unit economics

  • Establish what it actually costs us to acquire a seller mandate through each channel. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it — replacing it with a real number is one of the most valuable things you can do in your first six months.

  • Define how we value a lead before it becomes a deal. Our conversion event is months away from first contact and worth a lot when it lands, so you'll need a sensible proxy to steer spend against.

Build the measurement first

  • Build the reporting that tells the team which channels are working, and be the person who questions a number that looks too good.

  • Make the case for manda clearly: what the process involves, how long each step takes, and why we're different from a traditional broker.

  • Use our completed deals, our team's track record and our acquisition finance offering as proof, and test what actually persuades a cautious owner to start a conversation about selling.

Help us reach better buyers

  • Sellers come first, but manda is a two-sided market. Once seller supply is working, you'll help us reach acquirers who are serious, credible and ready to transact, including buyers who are new to iwoca.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in acquisition, growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup, scale-up or new venture where you had to work out what to do rather than execute someone else's plan.

  • M&A, marketplace or two-sided experience, especially where supply rather than demand was the constraint.

  • Comfortable with a long, low-frequency, high-value conversion. Selling a business is nothing like taking out a loan: the cycle runs for months, volumes are low, and you'll have to make decisions on thin and noisy data without waiting for statistical comfort.

  • Numerate and data-literate. You build the measurement before the campaign, you can read a funnel, and you're happy owning the numbers you report.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team and no agency to hide behind: you'll write the copy, brief the page, set up the tracking and pull the reporting yourself.

  • Experience driving applications or sign-ups into a live product journey, and comfortable working with product and engineering on the conversion steps you don't own yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience marketing to owner-managers of established SMEs, particularly around retirement, succession or exit.

  • You've personally owned a paid channel with a real budget, and you've killed one that wasn't working. We care as much about the second part as the first.

  • Regulated or financial services marketing experience.

  • Offline direct response experience, particularly direct mail.

  • Hands-on with HubSpot, GA4 or similar, and comfortable with SQL or a BI tool like Looker.

The salary

We expect to pay from £55,000–£80,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

raw.title: Partnerships Manager
raw.description:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda (iwoca's M&A Platform)

We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day.

The role

Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them.

You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up.

It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses.

Key responsibilities include:

Build the introducer network

  • Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there.

  • Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens.

  • Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us.

Make referrals actually arrive

  • A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call.

  • Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them.

Make the channel scale

  • Judge every partnership by whether it adds referrals without adding work. A relationship that only produces when you're in the room isn't a channel yet.

  • Work out which partner technology is worth plugging into: the practice management and accounting software advisers already work in, tracked referral links and partner portals, and integrations that let a firm refer a client without leaving their own tools. You won't build these yourself, but you'll identify them, make the commercial case, and scope them with our Product Builder.

  • Look for partners who can bring a book rather than one client at a time. One firm with hundreds of owner-managed clients is worth more to us than ten firms with five, if we can find a way to surface the right candidates across the whole book.

Work iwoca's existing network

  • iwoca already has a broker network and a partnerships function with relationships across the SME economy. Working out where manda fits into those relationships is far faster than starting cold, and it's the first place to look.

Events and community

  • Build a focused programme of events worth attending and, where it makes sense, running our own: succession and exit planning, accountancy and adviser events, industry gatherings, and business owner peer communities.

  • Judge them on referrals rather than attendance, and stop going to the ones that don't produce. Events are how you find and land partners, not how the channel scales.

Prove the channel pays

  • Establish what a referral actually costs us once your time, any partner incentives and events are counted, and how many convert into a signed mandate. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in partnerships, channel or business development, ideally B2B, where you built or substantially grew a referral channel rather than inheriting one that already worked.

  • You've done the full cycle yourself: identified the target firms, got the meetings, agreed the terms, and then managed the relationship afterwards.

  • A background in M&A, marketplaces, business broking or business transfer.

  • You understand that the work starts after the agreement is signed, and you have the discipline to keep a channel warm over months rather than weeks.

  • Numerate and honest about performance. You track referrals by partner, you know which relationships are producing, and you say so when one isn't.

  • You think in systems as well as relationships. You can tell the difference between a partnership that scales and one that only works while you're pushing it, and you'd rather replace your own manual work with an integration than defend it.

  • Comfortable specifying technology without building it. You can look at a partner's tools and our product, work out what would make us the path of least resistance, and scope it clearly enough for a product team to build.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team to delegate to: you'll build the target list, send the emails, run the meetings and keep the CRM straight yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience with accountancy, legal or wealth management channels specifically.

  • Experience running an event programme with commercial targets attached to it.

  • Familiarity with the UK succession and exit planning landscape.

  • Comfortable treating a CRM as a discipline rather than an afterthought, ideally HubSpot.

  • You've shipped a partner integration, an embedded referral flow or a software marketplace listing, or worked closely with a product team on one.

  • Familiar with the software UK accountancy practices and advisers actually work in, such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, IRIS or Dext.

The salary

We expect to pay £55,000–£80,000 and an annual performance based bonus for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it. Experience inside a structured creative testing program.   • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

     

What you’ll bring

We encourage our vets to work cases up thoroughly and provide the clinical freedom to pursue areas of interest, whether that's surgery, medicine, dentistry, ECC or another passion. You'll enjoy a rewarding mix of consultations and surgery, with exposure to everything from routine procedures through to advanced dentistry, orthopaedic surgery and emergency presentations.

  • Senior clinical role with no management responsibilities
  • Work alongside certificate holders in Cardiology, Small Animal Surgery and Small Animal Medicine
  • Diverse first-opinion caseload including cats, dogs, rabbits, small furries, exotics and occasional poultry
  • Excellent balance of consulting, surgery, inpatient care and case continuity
  • Exposure to advanced dentistry, orthopaedics and emergency and critical care cases
  • Modern facilities including a dedicated theatre, separate prep area, digital radiography, dental x-ray and a new ultrasound scanner
  • Separate cat ward, isolation facilities and excellent staff amenities
  • Part of a supportive three-practice network alongside our Stokesley and Copeland clinics, offering additional clinical support and expertise
  • Dedicated Practice Director supporting all three sites, with access to experienced Clinical Directors across the wider group
  • Friendly, highly experienced nursing and client care team with a strong culture of teamwork and knowledge sharing
 

How You'll Make a Difference

 

As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you'll play a key role in delivering exceptional patient care while supporting the development of the wider clinical team.

Alongside managing a varied first-opinion caseload, you'll act as an experienced clinical presence within the practice, helping to support recent graduates and less experienced colleagues through mentoring, case discussion and collaborative working.

  • Deliver high-quality medical and surgical care across a varied first-opinion caseload
  • Manage and work up medical and surgical cases to a high clinical standard

  • Support and mentor new graduate and early-career Veterinary Surgeons
  • Contribute to clinical discussions and continuous improvement in patient care
  • Work closely with the veterinary, nursing and client care teams to deliver outstanding patient outcomes
  • Help foster a positive, supportive and collaborative clinical culture

Working Pattern

  • Full-time position
  • 40 hours across four days
  • Shared Saturday rota
  • Flexible working discussions welcomed

Life in Guisborough

 
Located on the edge of the stunning North York Moors, Guisborough offers the perfect blend of countryside, coastline, and community living. With beautiful walking routes, easy access to the Yorkshire coast, and excellent transport links into Middlesbrough, York, and Newcastle, the area provides a fantastic quality of life both in and out of work.
 
The practice enjoys a strong local reputation and loyal client base, creating the opportunity to build lasting relationships with clients while enjoying the benefits of working within a close-knit and supportive community.

Working Pattern

 
* Ideally 40 hours per week; however, we will accept part-time applications also 
* 4 x 10-hour shifts between 8 am - 7:30 pm 
 
 

General Responsibilities

 

*Deliver high-quality nursing care across theatre, inpatient care, diagnostics and medical cases

  • Proficient in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
  • Expertise with RDBMS, Data Warehousing, Data Modelling with relational SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&amp;P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp; </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <p>As a Sector Lead on our TMT (Technology, Media and Telecoms) Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research (TMT) you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.</p> <p>You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.</p> <p>You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp; </span>the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.</li> <li>Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution</li> <li>Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.</li> <li>Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.</li> <li>Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.</li> <li>Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.</li> <li>Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Healthcare, TMT or Energy &amp; Industrial sectors, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within TMT</li> <li>You bring deep domain expertise in Technology, Media &amp; Telecoms with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.</li> <li>You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.</li> <li>You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.</li> <li>You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.</li> <li>You have a strong command of project economics, capable of managing budgets, optimizing expert costs, and tracking ROI to ensure resource efficiency.</li> <li>You are adept at working cross-functionally with Directors of Research, Go-to-Market, Product, and Compliance to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.</li> <li>You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You maintain a strong understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality standards across all project types.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Recruiting Scams and Fraud</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">All official communications will come from an @<a href="http://alpha-sense.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://alpha-sense.com/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1740162734907000&amp;usg=AOvVaw2sfhQUZloRzVpQ4Yj1Ftlo">alpha-sense.com</a>&nbsp;email address.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1740162734907000&amp;usg=AOvVaw3I0CFwb1ser7ImCRD48YOl">Careers page</a>.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Implementation Consultant
description: monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition. Our team is growing and we are looking for an Implementation Consultant (Forward Deployed Consultant) to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will train, advise and consult, and build with customers to optimise their use of the monday.com AI work platform during the course of an AI transformation, implementation, or ongoing managed services engagement. You will design and build the AI-native solutions that get them there, from intelligent workflows and agents to the automations and reporting their business relies on. You will run engagements both independently and as a part of a delivery team collaborating with deployment strategists and engineers. Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Paris office. About the Role Lead AI transformation and implementation engagements for monday.com customers, designing and building tailored solutions using agents, vibe-coded applications, and other advanced capabilities of the monday AI work platform. Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, running the discovery that uncovers their desired business outcomes, and ensure successful adoption of the solutions you deliver across their organization. Consult on business process design, mapping how work moves through a customer's organization and recommending the process changes that should be made before the solution is built. Design sophisticated workflows and relational data structures within the monday.com platform to solve complex business cases, partnering with technical resources for data conversions, integrations, and agentic engineering. Actively leverage monday AI and external Generative/Agentic AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate complex business logic, and deliver intelligent workflows for our customers. Act as the project manager on standalone engagements, building and executing on project plans that ensure deliverables stay on-time and on-budget, and delivering defined scope alongside a deployment strategist on larger ones. Run online webinars, training sessions, consultations, and one-on-one demos that show customers how our product capabilities translate into business value. Produce the documentation, walkthroughs, and exit artifacts for your engagements that allow customers to operate, maintain, and extend what you built independently. Represent the voice of the customer by advocating for their needs and influencing the product development roadmap. Contribute the patterns and reusable assets you develop in the field back to our shared asset library. Requirements 3+ years of experience as a forward deployed consultant, implementation consultant, solutions consultant, or technical project manager in enterprise software. Experience leading software implementation or managed services projects that required hands-on build and system configuration in project management, CRM, service desk, or collaborative work management software. Fluency in Generative and Agentic AI tools, with a strong understanding of how to leverage AI in streamlining work productivity and building intelligent workflows and agents. Familiarity with what keeps AI reliable in production, including human review, checking outputs, and knowing when a deterministic automation is the better answer. Strong problem solving skills, rooted in computational thinking, systems design, and an understanding of relational data structures. Business process design and consulting experience, with the business acumen to frame an engagement around customer outcomes, and the judgment to read the implicit problem behind an explicit request. Working knowledge of integration platforms ( make.com , Zapier) sufficient to configure lightweight integrations yourself, with foundational knowledge of APIs (GraphQL) and MCP a plus. Strong customer-facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with client stakeholders and executives, and to clearly articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience. Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies across a changing set of customers and industries. Detail-oriented with strong project management skills, comfortable running engagements independently and working across several at once. Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, high energy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt. BA or BS degree preferred. Please note that this role is hybrid. Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available. monday.com is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description: Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit. The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible. The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability. A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning. Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects. Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research. Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations. Starting date: Fall 2026 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

<strong>Seller Experience</strong> and <strong>Channel Integration</strong> — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, &amp; Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.<br><br><strong>Location:</strong> Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Your Impact</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead and conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.</li> <li>Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h2> squads.</li> <li>Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.</li> <li>A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.</li> <li>Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.</li> <li>Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.</li> <li>Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Tech Stack</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Java (recent versions)</li> <li>Spring Framework</li> <li>SQL</li> <li>Cloud platforms</li> <li>Microservices architecture</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Languages</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>French</strong>: Full professional proficiency</li> <li><strong>English mandatory</strong>: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Our Hiring
