description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><a href="http://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a> is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.</p> <p>CRA's <a href="https://ecp.crai.com/">European Competition practice</a> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation.&nbsp;We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.</p> <p><em>Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our <a href="https://www.crai.com/">website</a>.</em></p> <p>The <a href="https://www.crai.com/antitrust-competition-economics-practice/">Antitrust &amp; Competition Economics</a> is hiring for the following European Union offices in Brussels, Belgium; Dusseldorf and Munich, Germany; Paris, France.</p> <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif;"> </span></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Senior Associates work closely with senior consultants on project teams and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in shaping the economic analysis and thinking of these cases. Successful candidates have a strong knowledge of economic concepts and a range of research and quantitative skills. A typical Senior Associate would:</p> <ul> <li>Identify and conceptualise issues, specifying rigorous economic models to analyse market issues and data, undertaking statistical and econometric estimation, and managing the work of research associate staff and colleagues;</li> <li>Supervise, train and mentor research associate staff;</li> <li>Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using market, industry or client-proprietary data;</li> <li>Act as a primary point of contact for lawyers and other industry or government clients on a variety of practice-relevant issues;</li> <li>Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R, SAS, Matlab, and Mathematica), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;</li> <li>Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; and</li> <li>Contribute to practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).</li> </ul> <p>Explore how CRA can help you&nbsp;<a href="http://www.crai.com/careers/accelerate">launch your career</a> and learn <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UJXu817TIZw">why PhDs choose CRA</a>.</p> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>PhD degree in economics with a completion date of December 2026/Summer 2027 and an academic focus on Applied Microeconomics or Applied Microeconometrics, with specializations like industrial organization, labor, health, behavioural and public economics, or other quantitative areas;</li> <li>Experience in Excel, Stata, Python, R, SQL, SAS, ArcGIS/ArcPy, or Cloud computing (Databricks/Spark, Google Cloud, Azure, AWS);</li> <li>Demonstrated understanding of, and ability to explain, economic, financial and/or accounting concepts, and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;</li> <li>Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;</li> <li>Effective written and oral communication skills;</li> <li>Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;</li> <li>Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;</li> <li>Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;</li> <li>Excellent time management and task prioritization skills; and</li> <li>Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.</li> </ul> <p><em>As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.</em></p> <p><strong>To Apply</strong></p> <p>To be considered for a <strong>position in Europe, submit through this posting</strong>:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Resume/CV</strong> – please include current address, email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Covering letter</strong> – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals. Also, please note if you have a location preference;</li> <li><strong>Research/Job market paper</strong> – please submit your original research or dissertation;</li> <li><strong>Letters of Recommendation</strong> – please have three (3) LORs submitted directly to ----- </ul> <p>To apply for one of our <strong>other global locations</strong>, please visit our <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/">Careers Site</a> to view available jobs.</p> <p>Interviews will begin following application close, with first round interviews occurring virtually. Candidates focusing their search on industry and consulting who need to be considered early should indicate that in the CRA online application and submit all materials as early as possible.</p> <p><strong>Career Growth and Benefits&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>CRA’s robust <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/talent-development/">skills development programs</a>, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with project management skills, training continues with team management/development, client presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.</li> <li>We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a competitive salary and superior benefits package (plus a sizeable performance bonus), <a href="https://www.crai.com/benefits/">wellness programming</a> to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/immigration-global-mobility/">immigration support</a> for foreign nationals and international business travelers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.   Why Now, Why Mirakl Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis. At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Annual gross salary range (package): €55,000 – €65,000
This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration and efficiency, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, Bazel, npm, and Python, with support for additional build tools coming soon. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as DuckDuckGo, Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.  Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.  Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results. Who You Are We are looking for a hardworking, driven Account Executive to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be the face of Develocity for enterprise prospects and customers in the New York and East Coast US region, focusing on driving revenue growth and new business acquisition. You'll act as a primary point of contact for our enterprise accounts in your territory. Your goal will be to guide these organizations on their journey with Develocity to unlock comprehensive data throughout the build process, empowering you to detect the unknown unknowns so you can ship faster, reduce risk, and lower costs, all while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be responsible for formulating and executing a sales strategy to grow your territory and acquire new customers. Responsibilities As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth. You will do this by: Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams. Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals. Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives. Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close. Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product. Mastering sales techniques like MEDPICC and Command of the Message to execute deals effectively. Attending industry events and Develocity-hosted sessions to strengthen relationships and generate new business. Analyzing wins and losses and sharing insights with internal teams to improve our approach. Documenting best practices in our sales playbook to contribute to continuous improvement. Being willing to travel to meet customers in person. Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of direct sales experience selling enterprise software to executives in large, complex organizations. A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quotas. Experience in the DevOps, Observability, or CI/CD space. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present to C-level executives. Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. Knowledge of MEDDPICC is a plus. Willingness to travel. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the following sales tools: Salesforce, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, and Gong. AI-first mindset to help with automating everyday tasks.  What We Offer Ability to work in a remote-first environment with flexible working hours. Work on a fast-growing product with a clear vision for the future. Close collaboration with an ambitious and experienced team and the opportunity to learn from them regardless of your experience level. Opportunities for growth in your career and in leadership responsibilities. In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite team meetings, and onboardings. Contribute to leading solutions in the new industry of Developer Productivity Engineering and work with cutting-edge DPE tools and practices. Competitive salaries and equity grants. Location Remote from Europe. While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.   Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth.

  • Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams.
  • Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals.
  • Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives.
  • Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close.
  • Clearly articulating the value of Develocity and providing customer feedback to enhance our product.
  • Mastering sales techniques like MEDPICC and Command of the Message to execute deals effectively.

  • Being willing to travel to meet customers in person.

Subscription state has to stay consistent&nbsp;across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment.&nbsp;Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our&nbsp;request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products&nbsp;depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or&nbsp;someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of&nbsp;you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one.&nbsp;That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling&nbsp;except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by&nbsp;taking scope and being right about it, fast.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption&nbsp;tracking, and our public TTS API</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it&nbsp;correct after you've moved on</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that&nbsp;freed you up for</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the&nbsp;product is going</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)</li> <li>Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended,&nbsp;what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual&nbsp;request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to&nbsp;finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this&nbsp;team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk&nbsp;through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>The France Based </strong>Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.</p><p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Refer them!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About the role

We're looking for two Payment Support Coordinators to join our Expert Services & Operations (ES&O) team on a short-term contract basis. You'll work directly on our linguist payment queue, helping to clear a backlog of payment requests and restoring a reliable, responsive experience for our global network of expert linguists.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You'll be triaging, investigating, and resolving payment issues across multiple systems, working closely with our existing coordinators and escalating to finance and engineering where needed.

What you'll be doing

  • Triaging and responding to incoming payment support tickets in Jira, prioritising by urgency and issue type

  • Investigating payment failures, discrepancies, and delays across the Lilt platform, Tipalti, Salesforce, and third-party processors (PayPal, Payoneer)

  • Resolving common issues including: Tipalti profile corrections, 2FA resets, banking detail mismatches, and manual offline payment (OPM) re-logging

  • Communicating clearly and empathetically with linguists to gather information and provide timely updates

  • Escalating technical breakages (e.g. platform stats sync issues) and rate discrepancies to the relevant internal teams

  • Maintaining accurate ticket notes and contributing to weekly reporting on queue volume and SLA adherence

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a payments, finance operations, or customer/vendor support role

  • Comfortable working across multiple systems simultaneously (Jira, Salesforce, or similar)

  • Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills — you'll be dealing with complex, sometimes sensitive payment disputes

  • Able to work independently, manage a high-volume queue, and know when to escalate

  • Experience with Tipalti or international payment platforms is a strong plus

  • Fluency in English required; additional languages are a bonus given our global linguist community

What to expect

This is a contract role. You'll be joining a small, collaborative ES&O team and will have clear ownership of a defined portion of the queue from day one.

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

LILT's mission is to make the world's information available to everyone, no matter the language they speak. Join our global community who thrive on innovation and excellence. Our collective knowledge, uniqueness, and skills deliver multilingual AI and human-verified services to Enterprises, Governments, and AI Developers around the world.

Earn money. Have fun. Advance human knowledge. Work on diverse projects from anywhere, any time you want. Get paid quickly and fairly, and build your professional network in a supportive community—all through a streamlined application process tailored to your expertise.

Information collected and processed as part of your application process, including any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to LILT's Privacy Policy at https://lilt.com/legal/privacy.

These tools are designed to support human decision-making and help us identify qualified candidates efficiently and objectively. All final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have any concerns, require accommodations, or would like to opt-out of the use of AI in our hiring process, please let us know at ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region.

Our ambition is to rethink occupational health in order to improve its impact on employees’ lives and the experience of healthcare professionals, leveraging Alan’s technology.

Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning!

👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here.

⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

  • Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

  • Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

  • People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

  • Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.

👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

  • At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

  • Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth.

  • Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading

  • Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus

  • Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail

  • Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones

  • Demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, and genuine enthusiasm for AI

  • Comfort interacting with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior profiles when needed

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team

  • Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more.

Ideally:

  • Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

  • Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal)

  • Note: a 100% Occupational Health background may not be the right cultural fit, but worth testing

🙏 What we offer

  • Location: 117 Quai de Valmy, Paris 10th, in a brand-new centre designed to support high-quality practice

  • Base salary: between €53,000 and €61,000 gross per year, depending on experience and level

  • Profit-sharing scheme: 10%, in line with Prévenir’s framework

  • Benefits: daily transport costs covered, company restaurant, RTT days and regular team events
